transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we lock the program, I need to hear from rights clearance and submissions staff — are there any outstanding issues with any of the competition titles, particularly 'After the Floodlights'? I want to make sure we're clear on all fronts before the public listing goes final.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Mara, I need to flag a rights issue with 'After the Floodlights.' I reviewed the executed music and archive license this morning, and there are three key constraints: (1) the festival may hold exactly one in-person public screening — so the planned screening is fine, but no additional screenings; (2) we may NOT publish any trailer or excerpt online, which conflicts with the draft program's planned online trailer; and (3) we must use the exact credit 'Courtesy of Northline Archive.' I should also note I haven't added the license summary to the programming file yet because the signed copy arrived in my separate clearance inbox.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Mara, I need to flag a premiere-status issue with 'After the Floodlights.' I checked the filmmaker's signed premiere declaration against the festival database today and confirmed that the film already had a public screening at the Harbor Documentary Week. That means it fails the competition's unpublished-premiere requirement. If we retain it, it must be offered as a single special screening rather than as a competition title. I should note I haven't updated the submission record yet because the database correction queue is still open.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Reclassify 'After the Floodlights' from competition title to single special screening, as the film fails the competition's unpublished-premiere requirement due to its prior public screening at Harbor Documentary Week.
Remove the planned online trailer for 'After the Floodlights' from the program, as the executed license prohibits publishing any trailer or excerpt online.
Ensure the exact credit 'Courtesy of Northline Archive' appears in all program materials for the film.
Limit 'After the Floodlights' to exactly one in-person public screening with no additional screenings, per the license constraint.
Add the license summary to the programming file from the separate clearance inbox.
Update the submission record to reflect the corrected premiere status once the database correction queue is processed.
